queries_run: Twilio export control OR entity list OR sanctions 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：關稅與貿易政策不確定性可能影響全球經濟與公司業務；關稅與通膨導致的價格上升可能提高營運費用；客戶受關稅衝擊可能降低使用量。
findings.excerpt: Additionally, increased prices resulting from the effects of tariffs and inflation could increase our operating expenses.

findings.claim: 10-K 揭露：公司產品受美國出口管制、海關與經濟制裁法規約束；部分產品含加密技術，可能受出口管制；已知有少數個人／實體涉及制裁地區的往來。
findings.excerpt: Encryption products and the underlying technology may also be subject to export control restrictions. Governmental regulation of encryption technology and regulation of exports of encryption products, or our failure to obtain required approval for our products, when applicable, could harm our international sales and adversely affect our revenue.

reg_tariff_export.note: 兩次搜尋未見 2026 年 Twilio 被列入實體清單、遭制裁或關稅專屬事件；僅有 10-K 一般性風險揭露。
